title: Mission Revision
description: An immutable, digest-bound Mission Revision: durable parent intent above one or more Execution Programs. Mission declares outcomes and ceilings; it never prescribes Task Cards, Runtime Tasks, waves, worktrees, files to edit, worker prompts, leases, provider bindings, execution profiles, or runtime task state. Authority: ADR-0024, ADR-0025, ADR-0027.

schema.description: Schema discriminator. Exactly one supported value in v1.

mission_id.description: Immutable Mission identity. Stable across every revision of the same Mission.

mission_revision.description: Revision ordinal. Immutable per revision; authoritative change creates a superseding revision rather than rewriting this one.

mission_owner.description: Canonical owner of the Mission definition, the Mission Revision, and the Mission verdict. Required, non-empty after normalization, authoritative, and part of Mission digest identity. Changing it requires a superseding Mission Revision.

objective.description: Durable outcome statement. Intent, never a plan.

targets.description: Declarative Mission targets. Blueprint may operationalize a subset and may not widen it.

acceptance_criteria.description: Mission Acceptance Criteria. Mission-owned; Program acceptance may contribute evidence toward these but never implies them (ADR-0027).

required.description: A required criterion cannot be weakened by Blueprint or Controller. Mission SATISFIED needs every required criterion SATISFIED or validly WAIVED.

evidence_requirements.description: Optional evidence obligations, expressed with the existing Program Execution evidence vocabulary. Mission does not create a parallel evidence plane.

evidence_type.description: A type from the shared evidence reference schema.

authority_ceiling.description: Outer authorization ceiling over the Mission, in the existing Program Execution action vocabulary: a total map, all ten actions required, each boolean. A ceiling, not an instruction. Effective Program authorization is the intersection of the applicable rules, exact action approval, this ceiling, the Blueprint ceiling, Controller policy, the Source Contract request, and the Rendered Contract binding. Lower layers narrow, never widen.

constraints.description: Declarative Mission scope and count ceilings. Mission v1 scope is declarative: no machine-defined Blueprint-subset grammar exists yet, so this claims no semantic subset checking. Executable subset enforcement belongs to Mission Admission.

max_programs.description: Aggregate ceiling on Programs admitted under this Mission.

deadline.description: Optional wall-clock ceiling. Format validation is enforced by the parser's FormatChecker, not by schema presence alone.

budgets.description: Mission-wide aggregate ceilings. An individual Program Controller has no authority to enforce Mission-wide totals; cross-Program accounting belongs to Mission Admission, which this contract does not build.

termination.description: Immutable Mission Revision termination definition. Participates in digest identity; mutable lifecycle state stays separate.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative annotation. Incapable of changing authorization, scope, acceptance, budgets, termination, or ownership. Structurally forbidden planning/runtime fields must not be smuggled in here.
